stories.title: Fflint Wrecsam MS tells Senedd he waited a year for Betsi Cadwaladr appointment contact
stories.summary: An MS representing Fflint Wrecsam has told the Senedd he has waited a year without contact after being placed on a Betsi Cadwaladr out-patient waiting list, as he pressed the First Minister over NHS delays facing patients in Flintshire and Wrexham. stories.title: Deeside Ice Rink reopens Sunday after six weeks of maintenance
stories.summary: Deeside Ice Rink reopens to the public on Sunday 19 July, following six weeks of essential maintenance. A brand-new ice surface has been prepared ahead of the reopening. stories.title: Welsh Government sets out first steps toward a broadcasting authority for Wales
stories.summary: The Welsh Government has set out its first steps toward creating a Shadow Broadcasting and Communications Authority for Wales. Any formal body is not expected to exist until 2028. stories.title: Cancer remains leading cause of death in Wales, new figures show
stories.summary: Cancer remained the leading cause of death in Wales in 2025, accounting for more than a quarter of all deaths. There were 9,053 deaths from cancer in Wales in 2025, according to the Welsh Cancer Intelligence and Surveillance Unit (WCISU), part of Public Health Wales. stories.title: Flintshire Foodbank warns warehouse is “never been so empty”
stories.summary: Flintshire Foodbank has issued an urgent appeal, saying its warehouse has never been so empty. The charity said: “We’re very worried.
